searchText: Hello, I'm having trouble installing EEST: ``` user@pop-os:~/sources/ethereum/execution-spec-tests$ uv sync --all-extras error: Failed to generate package metadata for `ethereum-execution-spec-tests==1.0.0 @ editable+.` Caused by: Failed to parse entry for: `ethereum` Caused by: Can't combine URLs from both `project.dependencies` and `tool.uv.sources` ``` In fact, if I removed `tool.uv.sources` entry from the pyproject.toml, things appear to progress smoothly, not sure what it's about or what is the proper solution (or if it's an issue with my local installation). Can you try upgrading `uv`? Try `uv self update`. That didn't work out of the box, I needed to completely uninstall and reinstall uv, which seems to have jammed at some old cargo version (?). Thank you for the pointer 🙂 Sorry about that. I recommend to install `uv` using `curl` (not via `pip`). If installed via `curl`, `uv self udpate` should work (it's not supported if it's `pip` installed).

excerpts.author: pdobacz
excerpts.content:
Hello, I'm having trouble installing EEST:

```
user@pop-os:~/sources/ethereum/execution-spec-tests$ uv sync --all-extras
error: Failed to generate package metadata for `ethereum-execution-spec-tests==1.0.0 @ editable+.`
  Caused by: Failed to parse entry for: `ethereum`
  Caused by: Can't combine URLs from both `project.dependencies` and `tool.uv.sources`
```
In fact, if I removed `tool.uv.sources` entry from the pyproject.toml, things appear to progress smoothly, not sure what it's about or what is the proper solution (or if it's an issue with my local installation).

excerpts.author: danceratopz
excerpts.content: Can you try upgrading `uv`? Try `uv self update`.

excerpts.author: pdobacz
excerpts.content: That didn't work out of the box, I needed to completely uninstall and reinstall uv, which seems to have jammed at some old cargo version (?). Thank you for the pointer 🙂
